_field_guide.description: Per-iteration verifier output. One report per verifier per iteration. Read by the attuner agent to revise the draft. Archived to attune/iter-N/ for trajectory inspection.

summary: One sentence: overall assessment of this iteration's draft from this verifier's perspective.

findings.category: filler | hedge | corporate_phrase | dead_metaphor | survey_voice | latent_drift | jargon_missing | etc.
findings.excerpt: The problematic text, copied verbatim from the draft. May be a sentence, a phrase, or a full paragraph.
findings.diagnosis: One sentence: what is wrong with this excerpt.
findings.suggestion: One sentence: what to do instead. The attuner uses this as the revision target.

metrics._description: Verifier-specific quantitative measurements. Schema varies per verifier.

_resonance_example.probe_question: What is the slow cancellation of the future?
_resonance_example.baseline_comparison: Matches Fisher idiom in 8/10 phrasal markers

flagged_phrases: at the end of the day
flagged_structures: em-dash buffer spacing in the opening movement

halt_reason: Optional: if the verifier judges that further iteration will not help (e.g., corpus is the bottleneck, not the draft), set true and explain.
